title: The Oracle and the Algorithm, Side by Side
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Interactive infographic overlay that compares the Delphic oracle and a modern predictive model across six matched stages, with hover tooltips, a click-to-open infobox, and a quiz mode.

learningObjectives: Compare how the Delphic oracle and a modern predictive model answer questions across six matched stages.
Name, for each stage, one way the two are alike and one way the parallel breaks.
prerequisites: Chapter 19: machine learning, training data, and language models

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Side-by-side comparison followed by retrieval practice
keyQuestions: Whose experience was in the data, and is mine like theirs?
Who is free to disagree with the answer?
commonMisconceptions: The oracle was an early algorithm, so it was just a data center.
A prediction that comes true proves the model was accurate.
A human in the loop is a safeguard even when the human cannot disagree.
assessmentOpportunities: Nine-question quiz mode: click the tile that matches each idea

controls.name: Explore
controls.description: Default mode: hover a tile for a tooltip, click it for the infobox.

controls.name: Quiz Mode
controls.description: Hides the name pills and asks nine questions answered by clicking a tile.
